root_idea.summary: The root centers on what comes after or takes the place of something, on being behind or contrary, and on alteration or change.
root_idea.development: The lexical branches develop from succession and replacement, spatial or temporal opposition to what is ahead, and change from an earlier state. These principles yield meanings such as succession, representation, remaining behind, disagreement, alternation, and deterioration.

qac_form_accounting.reason: The locative group is the same lexical item خَلْفٌ used adverbially for position or time behind/after.

senses.definition: To come after, follow, or succeed another.
senses.usage_conditions: Used of a person or generation coming after another, whether the predecessor remains or has gone.

senses.definition: To take another’s place or act as his substitute.
senses.usage_conditions: The construction may describe assuming someone’s position, duties, or place, either during his absence or after his departure.

senses.definition: To leave someone behind.
senses.usage_conditions: The passive Quranic form describes people who were left behind rather than accompanying others.

senses.definition: To disagree with, oppose, or act contrary to someone or something.
senses.usage_conditions: May be construed with a person, command, matter, or course of action; the opposition may be expressed in conduct or opinion.

senses.definition: To fail to fulfill or break a promise, undertaking, or appointed time.
senses.usage_conditions: The promise-breaking sense concerns a future commitment or expected fulfillment; in the passive, the person or thing may be described as not being given what was promised.

senses.definition: To replace, restore, or provide a substitute for something that has gone.
senses.usage_conditions: Used with God or another agent as subject when something lost, spent, or absent is supplied by a replacement.

senses.definition: To remain or hold back behind others; to fail to go along.
senses.usage_conditions: The construction may describe staying behind a group or falling short of carrying out an action.

senses.definition: To differ, disagree, or dispute with one another.
senses.usage_conditions: Used when people, parties, or opinions take different positions or courses; passive forms can present disagreement as having arisen.

senses.definition: To appoint or make someone successors, deputies, or those who take the place of others.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic construction presents succession or stewardship as conferred by an agent, especially God, upon a people or community.

senses.definition: Left behind; one who remains behind.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic plural denotes people who did not accompany a departing group or expedition.

senses.definition: One who fails to fulfill a promise or undertaking.
senses.usage_conditions: The participle describes a person characterized by failure to keep a promised commitment.

senses.definition: Entrusted with stewardship or made a successor.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic plural portrays people as entrusted with what has been placed in their care or authority.

senses.definition: Differing or disagreeing in opinion, position, or assertion.
senses.usage_conditions: Used of people, speech, or claims when they do not coincide or agree.

senses.definition: Various, diverse, or differing in kind, appearance, color, or quality.
senses.usage_conditions: Used of created things and their observable properties; the difference need not imply opposition or contradiction.

senses.definition: One who remains behind or does not go forth with others.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic context the plural refers to people staying behind rather than joining an expedition.

senses.definition: A successor or substitute who takes the place of one who preceded him.
senses.usage_conditions: The word may refer to a successor after someone’s departure or death, or to one who assumes another’s position.

senses.definition: A vicegerent, steward, or appointed authority entrusted to act in the earth.
senses.usage_conditions: This sense emphasizes delegated authority or stewardship rather than mere chronological succession.

senses.definition: What is behind or after; the rear position or succeeding time.
senses.usage_conditions: Used as a noun or adverb with a pronoun or possessive construction for spatial or temporal position behind/after someone or something.

senses.definition: A remnant, generation, or people who come after others.
senses.usage_conditions: The word can denote a succeeding generation or remnant, sometimes with an explicitly negative evaluation in the surrounding expression.

senses.definition: A woman or other person remaining behind those who have departed.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic plural is explained as referring especially to women remaining in the homes while men go forth, though the lexical notion is remaining behind.

senses.definition: Contrary position, opposition, or opposite sides.
senses.usage_conditions: In مِن خِلَافٍ, the term indicates two things arranged on contrary or opposite sides.

senses.definition: Behind or after someone.
senses.usage_conditions: This temporal or positional use occurs in constructions such as خِلَافَكَ, meaning after or behind you.

senses.definition: Alternation or succession, with one thing following another.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic expression describes night and day as each replacing or following the other, and by extension as providing alternating times.

senses.definition: Alternation or succession, one thing following another.
senses.usage_conditions: Used of recurring natural sequences such as the alternation of night and day.

senses.definition: Difference, disagreement, or contradiction.
senses.usage_conditions: Used of opinions, speech, judgments, or parties that do not agree; contradiction is a contextual specialization of disagreement.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The back or rear side, especially the side of a house opposite its entrance.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A concrete spatial noun distinct from the general adverbial sense of being behind.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To seize someone from behind or come behind him to strike him.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A transitive physical action involving approach from the rear.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To speak of, defame, or act against someone behind his back.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Includes speech or conduct performed in another person’s absence.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To withdraw, go away, flee, or ascend.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: These are separately attested motion uses of the Form I verb.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become bad, corrupt, or lacking in good.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A character or evaluative use, not the neutral sense of succeeding another.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Foolishness, stupidity, deficient understanding, or lack of usefulness.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to a person or character described as intellectually deficient or unprofitable.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become altered or spoiled in taste or odor; specifically, the altered odor of a fasting mouth.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of water, milk, food, beverages, the mouth, or a disposition that has changed for the worse.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To draw or carry water for others; a water-drawer.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The noun and verb are associated with supplying water to people or animals.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To repair a garment by removing its worn middle and sewing the edges together, or by replacing a piece.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The related noun can denote the repaired garment or a patch.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To mix one substance with another, such as milk, saffron, or medicine with water.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A transitive material-mixture use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A pregnant she-camel, or a camel that has conceived after giving birth.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized pastoral term with several stated details concerning the stage of pregnancy.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An animal that has exceeded a named age stage, especially a camel beyond the bāzil stage.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A technical age designation applied to male or female camels and, more broadly, beasts.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A camel suffering a painful hind ailment and walking or leaning to one side.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Includes the specialized description of injury or pressure affecting the sheath and urine passage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The teat, extremity, or udder of a she-camel or other cloven-hoofed animal.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term may denote the whole udder or a particular teat according to the cited usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The shortest and thinnest rib next to the belly.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An anatomical term for the lower or innermost small rib.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A later growth, crop, leaf, fruit, or grain that appears after an earlier one.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of seasonal herbage, renewed leaves, later fruit, vine produce, or replacement sowing.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A disorder involving repeated evacuation, looseness, diarrhea, or disturbed digestion.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The expression can refer to frequent movement to the privy, purging, or a stomach disorder.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Obstinacy, contentiousness, or a strongly contrary disposition.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to a person, slave, companion, or character; this is a character specialization of contrariness.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Breach or non-fulfillment of a promise.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A noun for promise-breaking, especially in the future; distinct from the Form IV verb as a headword.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A tribe or household whose men have gone away, or the people remaining behind in their absence.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term can be used for either the absent group or those left present, depending on context.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Old and worn out, especially a worn skin vessel.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An adjectival or nominal description of age and deterioration.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The blade, head, or edge of an axe, adze, razor, or similar cutting tool.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Includes the specialized two-headed axe and the head of a razor or pointed tool.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A calamity or misfortune, especially a great one.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An idiomatic expression rather than a productive general sense of the root.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The sleeve of a shirt.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A concrete garment term.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A rear pole, side, or structural part of a tent or house.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: May denote a tent pole in the hinder part or the rear angles and sides of a tent.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An object suspended behind a rider or behind a carrying frame.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A concrete object-position term.

other_classical_meanings.definition: What remains in a trough, tank, or between the teeth after use.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to residual water or food.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A mixed or alternating set, such as offspring differing by sex from one year to another or children divided between male and female.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized application of alternation and difference to reproduction and offspring.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A woman shortly after childbirth, or a she-camel on the second day after giving birth.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized postpartum term; related usage also denotes the milk following the first colostrum.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Milk produced after the first colostrum.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A pastoral term for the later milk of a recently calved camel.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A narrow gap, road, valley, or watercourse between mountains.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A geographic noun, sometimes simply a mountain road or passage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A sharp arrow.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The lexical attribution is reported with a competing reading حَلِيفٌ, so the sense is specialized and less secure.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A district, province, or regional administrative territory, especially in Yemen.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The plural denotes such districts; a related usage refers to a community’s poor-rate.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The poor-rates or communal alms collected for a particular people.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized social and administrative use of the plural.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A willow-like tree or species of ṣafṣāf.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A collective plant name, with the lexical explanation connecting it to being carried or growing away from its original place.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become complicated, intricate, or confused.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is a Classical extension describing an affair that becomes difficult and thereby a subject of disagreement.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be unfaithful to a spouse by pursuing another in the spouse’s absence.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A construction describing conduct toward another person’s wife when the husband is absent.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The contrary or opposite of a thing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A general noun of opposition, distinct from the specific arrangement of things on opposite sides.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A frequent promise-breaker.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to a person characterized by repeatedly failing to keep promises.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To incline or lean to one side, said of a camel.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A physical description of an animal’s posture or gait.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Left-handedness.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An independently attested physical description of a person’s handedness.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Squinting or being cross-eyed.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An independently attested physical description of the eyes.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become pregnant, said of a she-camel.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A pastoral verb describing conception in a she-camel.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To bind one of a she-camel’s teats so that its young cannot suck it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A pastoral action performed by fastening the teat with a cord or similar restraint.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To weaken someone by causing frequent evacuation, said of medicine.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A causative medical use describing a medicine’s effect on the patient.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To bring a stallion again to a she-camel that has not conceived at once.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A pastoral breeding construction involving a second covering.

lane_unit_coverage.note: Reports a rare contronymic use, fulfilling a promise, without a secure assignment.
A rare animal-name assignment is reported, but its lexical identity is not secure.

cautions: The Quranic form خَلْفٌ combines nominal and locative/adverbial QAC groups; the latter is merged under the normalized dictionary headword خَلْفٌ.
خَالِفٌ and خَالِفَةٌ are normalized from Quranic plural forms; the feminine form preserves the explicitly reported Quranic interpretation of people, especially women, remaining behind.
The Form IV branch includes both failure to fulfill a promise and provision of a replacement; these are distinct constructions rather than merely stylistic translations.
Lane’s historical Quran references were not converted into modern verse locations unless the corresponding location was independently supplied by QAC.
unassigned_or_ambiguous_evidence: lane-unit:xlf:19893:g1:sub5 reports a rare contronymic use of أَخْلَفَ meaning fulfilling a promise; the evidence does not establish whether it belongs to the Quranic promise-breaking sense or should be treated as a separate branch.

lane-unit:xlf:19919:g1:sub7 gives a rare animal-name interpretation of أَخْلَفُ, but the passage itself attributes the meanings to a disputed poetic reading and does not permit a confident independent assignment.
